description: Search fintech products by text, category, market, API availability, agent access (has_mcp, has_sandbox, has_api) or customer type. Each product carries an agent_access object (api_available, docs_url, openapi_url, sandbox_url, llms_txt_url, auth_method, mcp_url) when any of these is set. Company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset. Each result carries provided_by, last_confirmed_at and sponsored; sponsorship never changes ordering. Arguments: q (or query) matched against name and short description; with no q the tool lists products alphabetically. cursor is the opaque next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

api_available.description: Only products with (true) or without (false) an API.

country.description: Market. Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

has_api.description: Only products with an API (API flag, API documentation or OpenAPI spec).

has_mcp.description: Only products with a public MCP server.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for. Omit for a plain alphabetical list.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

name: search_products
title: Search fintech products
